notes: JESD204 does not define OTP/fuse content as a protocol concept. The interoperability-relevant facts (version, subclass, resolution, lane rate, device IDs) are configured through the vendor control bus and transmitted in-band as the ILAS link-configuration octets; an implementation may back some with fuses, but the standard only requires they be configured/discoverable.
